description: One of the two counts the request service keeps, and what it has left.

limit.description:
How many the period allows. Absent where nothing limits them, which is a
different answer from a limit of nought.

period.description:
How long the period is, in the words a household says it in — absent where
the count runs from the beginning rather than over a window.

remaining.description: How many more they may ask for. Absent where nothing limits them.

used.description: How many the period has already counted against them.
